scripts.dev:local: set -a && eval "$(supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null </dev/null)" && set +a && VITE_SUPABASE_URL="$API_URL" VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY="$PUBLISHABLE_KEY" pnpm --filter @prolog/web dev
scripts.gen:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > packages/types/src/db.ts && prettier --write packages/types/src/db.ts
scripts.seed:derive: set -a && eval "$(supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null </dev/null)" && set +a && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning supabase/functions/scripts/derive-seed.ts
